14 weeks = 14 × 7 = 98 days.  
Add 7 more days → total added = 105 days.  
1554 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1554 not divisible by 4).  
09-01-1554 + 105 days: January has 31 days, so from Jan 9: 31 - 9 = 22 days used in Jan, leaving 105 - 22 = 83 days left.  
February 1554 has 28 days → 83 - 28 = 55 left.  
March has 31 days → 55 - 31 = 24 left.  
April has 30 days → 24 days into April = April 24.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1554-04-24
